macros.name: wordgroup

arg.snippet: wordgroup[${1:options}]{${2:row offset}}{${3:first word offset}}{${4:last word offset}}{${5:group id}}

macros.doc: This command creates a group spanning the words in the {⟨row-offset⟩}-th row of the matrix from position {⟨word-offset-beg⟩} to position {⟨word-offset-end⟩}. {⟨gid⟩} is a unique identifier for the group, that will be used to connect groups.
